en: Monochrome printed postcard showing a detailed architectural engraving of a richly decorated Baroque church façade with statues and a large dome behind it. A broad exterior staircase with stone balustrades and patterned railings leads up between the church and an adjacent palatial building; several small figures walk on the steps. The image is signed "Kreuzer" at the lower left, and there is a handwritten word resembling a place name centered in the lower margin.
